name: Oversampled 3D Ray March
definition: An oversampling technique where each fine sample owns the slab it is the midpoint of, clipped to the brick's segment, ensuring slab thicknesses tile [0, len] exactly at LOD interfaces.
summary: Oversampled 3D Ray March is a sampling strategy that resolves LOD boundary discontinuities by enforcing strict slab ownership and corrected exit-face probing, ensuring exact tiling without gaps.
